title: Expectation interest
summary: Expectation measures the position performance of the enforceable promise would have produced.
notes: Identify the promised performance, the actual position, avoided costs, and other qualifying losses before adding figures. Hawkins compares the promised and actual hand; Naval Institute estimates sales profits lost because of premature sales. A gain to the defendant is not automatically the claimant’s expectation loss. The Sullivan posture shows why different interest measures can share some components. The early chapters introduce these distinctions without supplying the course’s later complete rules on damage limitations.
